blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers has asked whether Vice President Sara Duterte’s frequent criticism of the Marcos administration is connected to the alleged entry of Chinese funds into a company and foundation linked to her, saying it might constitute foreign-funded destabilization. Barbers referred to accusations by former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV that P319 million from Chinese corporations went to a banana chip company owned by Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, while the Chinese Embassy donated P150 million to the vice president’s foundation.
